generated_by: Understand Anything Pipeline v2.0 — construction business domain flow (NOT file-type buckets)

nodes.name: SOP - Standard Operating Procedure
nodes.summary: Authoritative control document defining how work is performed. Top of the governed work spine. Establishes the method, safety requirements, and compliance framework for each construction activity.

nodes.name: SWK - Safe Work Method Statement
nodes.summary: Risk assessment and safe work method derived from SOP. Identifies hazards, controls, and PPE requirements for field execution.

nodes.name: WI - Work Instruction
nodes.summary: Step-by-step execution instruction verifying SWK compliance. The granular task sequence a worker follows on site.

nodes.name: Checklist
nodes.summary: Verification instrument confirming WI steps were executed. Each item maps to a WI step with pass/fail/NA and evidence.

nodes.name: Action Plan
nodes.summary: Training and corrective action plan. Assigns owners, dates, and deliverables to close gaps from checklists or audits.

nodes.name: LMS - Learning Management System
nodes.summary: Training delivery and competency tracking. Certifies personnel have completed required training. Feeds back into SOP review cycle.

nodes.name: Atlas Token Registry
nodes.summary: Machine-built resolver substrate: 26,748 canonical tokens, 53,317 aliases, 10 kinds. Governs all document references across the work spine.

nodes.name: Token Verification & Watchdog
nodes.summary: Continuous verification: 1,921 citations, 495 unique tokens, 100% resolution. Six watchdog runs confirmed zero drift on 2026-05-11.

nodes.name: BD5 Cross-Corpus Audit
nodes.summary: M6 substrate hardening across 6 corpora: 11,944 nodes, 16,047 edges, 1,258 communities. Same-tick remediation for CANON corpus.
